brief.t: Today's single most important lever is the Kenna meeting — but it is not on your calendar. It gates the Atlas Eternal formula, twenty-six thousand five hundred dollars ready to go into production, and Pure Good at roughly three hundred twenty-nine thousand dollars. Confirm the time with Kenna first thing and hold that meeting.

Terra Lotus, seventy-eight thousand five hundred eighty dollars, is our biggest deal at fifty-two percent of the monthly target. Aidan has now gone two business days silent. I'm escalating in the priority channel this morning and will text you if he stays dark.
Atlas Eternal production is queued the moment you have the formula from Kenna. The thirteen thousand two hundred fifty dollar deposit is already in; the same amount is due on completion.
New lead overnight: Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance wants four thousand-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion, and he supplies the fragrance oil. Worth qualifying today.
Customer care flag: Charles Thompson at Brighten Path says his beard balm and body wash samples never arrived. A quick fix here keeps it from souring.

The ads are still one word from you — say revert ads to manual and I flip both campaigns off Maximize Conversions. Heads up: our Google Ads data connection is fully down on a retired version, so I can't live-verify until it's fixed.
On your calendar today: the AF Brand meeting at three PM Eastern with Toney, JJ, James, and Laura.

kb.a: The Kenna meeting is today's top lever and is NOT on Sam's calendar as of this refresh — confirm the time first thing. It gates two things: the Atlas Eternal formula (unblocks the $26,500 production run) and Pure Good at roughly $329K. Get the Atlas formula in hand and raise Pure Good's next step on the same call.

Sam's single lane today is the Kenna meeting first — confirm it's happening and hold it, because it unlocks both the Atlas formula and Pure Good. After that: let the Consultant escalate Terra Lotus with Aidan, and give the one-word ads go/no. Don't switch to lower-value work until the Kenna gate is cleared.

Terra Lotus is a $78,580 opportunity, about 52% of the $150K monthly target. Aidan owns the volume-pricing conversation and has now been silent two business days on the Aug 10 ask. The Consultant is escalating in the priority channel this morning and will text Sam if Aidan stays dark. PLL sends nothing customer-facing until Aidan reports back.

Atlas Eternal is $26,500 with the $13,250 deposit already PAID (QuickBooks Inv #1050, Ryne Bell). The balance of $13,250 is due on completion. Production is ready to start the moment Sam has the formula from Kenna today — that's the only remaining gate.

Pure Good is a roughly $329K opportunity gated behind the chemist formula from Kenna. Today's Kenna meeting is the moment to advance it — confirm the meeting time first, since it is not currently on the calendar.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance is a new overnight inbound: he wants 4,000-plus 8-ounce tubes of scented body lotion and will supply the fragrance oil himself. Qualify formula, packaging, and timeline; no price is set yet. Buyer-supplied fragrance simplifies our scope.

Charles Thompson at Brighten Path Solutions reports his beard balm and body wash samples never arrived. This is a customer-care flag — chase the shipment/tracking and make it right so it doesn't sour a live prospect. He also shared private open-house website access.

Ashley Harmon at ApothikSKIN (botanical skincare) replied: she's targeting early next year at 1,000-3,000 units per SKU, with custom formulas, testing/refinement, packaging, and MOQ/pricing all in play. Warm, not urgent — keep it moving with a clear next step and documentation.
The AF Brand meeting is on Sam's calendar today at 3:00-4:00 PM ET with a working video link. Attendees include Toney Wells, JJPitenis, James, Laura Hoskins, and Sam.

Both net-new campaigns are still on Maximize Conversions with essentially no conversion tracking, so they optimize toward a signal that isn't there. Sam can say 'revert ads to manual' and the Consultant flips both to Manual CPC — one change, under cap. Important honesty note: the Google Ads data connection is fully down on a retired API version, so live verification is dark until it's fixed; figures shown are the Ads Agent's, not independently confirmed.

Oreka / Nadia Dupuis is CLOSED and paid ($8,555, 1,000-unit Peptide Cream) and in production. Laura owns customer communication and Nikkie's commission is paid. No action needed — do not resurface as a decision.

The PLL CRM browser session is signed out at the login screen. Restoring pll_tasklet_consultant access is needed for CRM fix verification, Aidan's purchasing knowledge-base extraction, Shopify sync verification, and UnShrink It verification. Carried CRM figures are not live verification.

OpenSend outbound needs Sam's approvals: three lookalike domains, a sending platform, a separate PLL Outbound Agent with its own login, a booking-calendar URL, and ICP Tier A sign-off. Domain and inbox warmup takes two to three weeks, so every day of delay pushes pipeline creation out.

Victor Armendarez has a 4,000-unit, two-SKU opportunity (Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel). The quote still needs confirmed packaging, fill, labor, and overhead from Ronald; do not issue pricing until the cost basis is complete.

The website/forms lane is agent-owned and in progress. Contact forms verify delivering to sam@prvtlabellabs.com and the address is migrated. The real gaps: Book a Call has no scheduler wired and hCaptcha may be silently dropping leads. Waiting on Sam's booking URL (his current one doesn't attach a Google Meet link). Nothing publishes without Sam's approval.

Aidan's Command Lab is live and self-publishing its 7 AM brief. It still needs Aidan to reconnect his own CRM and WhatsApp so it can incorporate CRM tasks and supplier chats instead of relying on Outlook only.
